.Synopsis for Jupiter Inlet to Ocean Reef FL out to 60 nm and for East Cape Sable to Bonita Beach FL out to 60 nm...

Gusty east-northeasterly winds will continue across Atlantic waters today, while winds across Gulf waters should drop below Small Craft Advisory criteria by this afternoon. A Small Craft Advisory remains in effect for Gulf waters through early this afternoon, and Atlantic waters through Friday evening. Wave heights are expected to reach the 8-10 foot range for Atlantic waters and 2-3 feet for Gulf waters through this evening. Winds and waves could become locally higher in any shower or thunderstorm activity.
